'''2016 EGP Day 2 Jonny Chu LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at [[2016 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jonny Chu]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused|Theed-L-wehaveaplan.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-endor-grand-prix/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013130058/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2016-endor-grand-prix.html Internet Archive]
